issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct equation (26) by showing that the quotient is homogeneous of degree zero and bounded between positive constants for any positive definite $\boldsymbol{\tilde{\Sigma}}$, and remove the claim that the limit is $0$ or $+\infty$ depending on the definiteness of $\boldsymbol{\Sigma} - \boldsymbol{\tilde{\Sigma}}^{-1}$.
issues.overall_effect: The condition $\boldsymbol{\Sigma} - \boldsymbol{\tilde{\Sigma}}^{-1} \succeq 0$ presented in Table 3 for the multivariate VG domain transformation is based on this erroneous limit split. In reality, $h_1^{VG}$ is already uniformly bounded on the boundary for any positive definite $\boldsymbol{\tilde{\Sigma}}$ when $\tilde{\nu} = \frac{2T}{\nu} - d$.
issues.title: False asymptotic limits for the multivariate VG boundary ratio function
issues.why_classification: The error is localized to the asymptotic evaluation of the ratio in equation (26). Correcting it shows that $h_1^{VG}$ is bounded regardless of whether $\boldsymbol{\Sigma} - \boldsymbol{\tilde{\Sigma}}^{-1} \succ 0$, so no algorithmic architecture, rate guarantee, or formal theorem is invalidated.
